messages:
suzanne_oncall: :rotating_light: Observed growing memory on gpu-node-7, paged-attn allocator steady climb ~100MB/hr, now at 88%.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-1769998881 - gpu-node-7 high memory / paged-attn slow creep (auto-alert)
suzanne_oncall: Triggering on-call. @devon_runtime can you take a look? We’re seeing repeated CUDA OOMs in logs and container restarts.
devon_runtime: Looking. attaching recent pod logs snippet:
```
kubectl logs -n inference runtime-pod-7 --tail=200
E cuda: OutOfMemoryError: CUDA OOM on GPU 0, tried to allocate 512 MiB
[...]
WARN paged_attn: kvcache fragment count rising: 129 -> 312 -> 586
```
Trying a quick `nvidia-smi` on node shows GPU mem steady increase.
maria_sre: Node-level metrics show non-evicting GPU allocations tied to kv-cache pages, not freed during attention paging handoffs. Potential fragmentation.
tyler_support: Any customer impact yet? We have a few 5xxs on hosted API v2 for customers in us-west.
suzanne_oncall: Customer impact: error spike ~3% for v2 endpoints for last 20m, some requests retried by clients. Not widespread but visible in SLO alerts.
carla_eng: Can we temp-fall back routing of v2 to a compatible model variant on other nodes? Suggest set routing policy to prefer dedicated pool for high-memory models.
devon_runtime: Will try to disable paged-attn on a subset of pods to confirm. Patch command:
```
kubectl patch deployment runtime -n inference --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"PAGED_ATTENTION_ENABLED","value":"false"}]}]}}}}'
```
devon_runtime: Rolling disable to 10% canary now.
ops-bot: Rollout started: runtime deployment patch (canary=10%) by devon_runtime
suzanne_oncall: FYI preserving logs to attach to postmortem. @maria_sre please capture heap snapshots and coredump if pod OOMs again.
maria_sre: Capturing heap via gcore on suspected pod and enabling extra GC metrics. Also increasing eviction aggressiveness for kv cache.
tyler_support: Notifying impacted customers with advisory: intermittent 5xx; mitigation in progress. Draft msg sent to #customer-ops for review.
carla_eng: If disabling paged-attn stabilizes memory, we should add automatic fallback on OOM with model-variant routing. Filed an internal ticket.
devon_runtime: Canary pods stable for 12m, memory climb flattened on canary. No new CUDA OOMs in canary.
suzanne_oncall: Good. Increasing rollout to 50%.
ops-bot: Rollout update: runtime deployment patch (canary=50%)
maria_sre: Observed reduced kv fragment growth on canary. Node gpu-node-7 still healing, planning to drain and reprovision kernel.
carla_eng: Plan for follow-ups: 1) short-term: auto-fallback route + conservative kv cache eviction thresholds; 2) medium: allocator defrag pass and add metrics for per-page refcounts; 3) long-term: allocator redesign to avoid fragmentation under long-lived queries.
tyler_support: Customers notified. No escalations yet but watching.
suzanne_oncall: Marking incident as mitigated for now, will keep monitoring 2h. Please add your action items to the incident board.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: INC-1769998881 status=mitigated assignees=[devon_runtime, maria_sre, carla_eng]
suzanne_oncall: Thanks team :thumbsup: We’ll run a formal postmortem with timeline and customer impact notes.
